# oncallalert_service (Resource)

A service that receives alerts and escalates them with an escalation policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oncallalert_service" "api" {
  name                 = "Public API"
  description          = "api.example.com"
  escalation_policy_id = oncallalert_escalation_policy.primary.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `escalation_policy_id` (String) ID of the escalation policy.
- `name` (String) Unique name.

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import oncallalert_service.example <id>
```
